reputation.en: The school built a strong reputation for science education over many years.
reputation.zh: 這所學校多年來建立了良好的科學教育聲譽。

rescue.en: The documentary follows a rescue team helping hikers after a storm.
rescue.zh: 紀錄片跟拍救援隊在暴風雨後協助登山客。

resemblance.en: There is a clear resemblance between the two historical maps.
resemblance.zh: 這兩張歷史地圖之間有明顯的相似之處。

resemble.en: These clouds resemble waves when viewed from the mountain.
resemble.zh: 從山上看，這些雲看起來像波浪。

reservoir.en: The reservoir supplies water to several nearby communities.
reservoir.zh: 這座水庫供水給附近數個社區。

reside.en: Many species reside in the protected wetland throughout the year.
reside.zh: 許多物種全年棲息在這片受保護濕地。

residence.en: The historic residence was converted into a public museum.
residence.zh: 這棟歷史宅邸被改建成公共博物館。

resident.en: Each resident received information about the upcoming road repair.
resident.zh: 每位居民都收到即將進行道路維修的資訊。

residential.en: The new bus route passes through a quiet residential area.
residential.zh: 新的公車路線會經過一個安靜的住宅區。

resign.en: The club leader chose to resign after finishing the semester.
resign.zh: 社團幹部在學期結束後選擇辭職。

resignation.en: Her resignation created an opening on the student committee.
resignation.zh: 她的辭職讓學生委員會出現一個空缺。

resistance.en: The material showed strong resistance to heat during the experiment.
resistance.zh: 這種材料在實驗中展現出良好的耐熱性。

resistant.en: This plant is resistant to dry conditions and strong sunlight.
resistant.zh: 這種植物能耐乾燥環境和強烈日照。

resolution.en: The committee reached a resolution after discussing the issue carefully.
resolution.zh: 委員會仔細討論後就此議題達成決議。

resort.en: The coastal resort closes several facilities during the rainy season.
resort.zh: 這座海濱度假村在雨季會關閉部分設施。

respectable.en: The team achieved a respectable result despite limited preparation time.
respectable.zh: 儘管準備時間有限，團隊仍取得相當不錯的成果。

respectful.en: Students kept the discussion respectful even when they disagreed.
respectful.zh: 即使意見不同，學生仍維持尊重的討論態度。

respondent.en: Each survey respondent answered the same set of questions.
respondent.zh: 每位問卷受訪者都回答相同的一組問題。

restoration.en: The restoration of the old theater took nearly three years.
restoration.zh: 這座老劇院的修復工程花了將近三年。

restraint.en: The debate showed restraint and avoided unnecessary personal attacks.
restraint.zh: 這場辯論保持克制，避免不必要的人身攻擊。

restriction.en: The temporary restriction limits access while repairs are underway.
restriction.zh: 維修期間的臨時限制會管制進入。

restroom.en: A public restroom is located beside the visitor center.
restroom.zh: 遊客中心旁有一間公共洗手間。

resume.en: Classes will resume on Monday after the short holiday break.
resume.zh: 短假結束後，課程將在星期一恢復。

retail.en: The report compares retail prices across several online stores.
retail.zh: 報告比較數家網路商店的零售價格。

retreat.en: The school organized a weekend retreat focused on teamwork and leadership.
retreat.zh: 學校舉辦了一場以團隊合作與領導為主題的週末活動。

retrieve.en: Students can retrieve saved files from the shared class folder.
retrieve.zh: 學生可以從班級共用資料夾取回已儲存的檔案。

reunion.en: The alumni reunion brought former classmates back to the school campus.
reunion.zh: 校友聚會讓昔日同學重返校園。

revelation.en: The final chapter contains a revelation that changes the reader's understanding.
revelation.zh: 最後一章有一項揭露，改變讀者對故事的理解。

revenge.en: The novel shows how revenge can prolong conflict between two families.
revenge.zh: 這本小說呈現報復如何延長兩個家庭之間的衝突。

revenue.en: Ticket sales provide an important source of revenue for the museum.
revenue.zh: 門票收入是博物館重要的營收來源。

reverse.en: Press this button to reverse the direction of the animation.
reverse.zh: 按下這個按鈕可反轉動畫的方向。

revival.en: The neighborhood saw a revival after several old buildings were restored.
revival.zh: 數棟老建築修復後，這個社區重新恢復活力。

revive.en: The festival helped revive interest in traditional local crafts.
revive.zh: 這場節慶重新喚起人們對地方傳統工藝的興趣。

revolt.en: The history class studied the causes of a nineteenth-century revolt.
revolt.zh: 歷史課研究一場十九世紀起義的成因。

revolution.en: The textbook explains how the industrial revolution changed production and cities.
revolution.zh: 課本說明工業革命如何改變生產方式與城市。

revolutionary.en: The invention was considered revolutionary because it changed communication worldwide.
revolutionary.zh: 這項發明被視為革命性的，因為它改變了全球通訊。

revolve.en: The planets revolve around the Sun at different speeds.
revolve.zh: 各行星以不同速度繞太陽運行。

rhetoric.en: The class analyzed political rhetoric without supporting any particular party.
rhetoric.zh: 班上分析政治修辭，但不支持任何特定政黨。

rhyme.en: The poem uses rhyme to create a clear musical pattern.
rhyme.zh: 這首詩運用押韻形成明顯的音樂節奏。

rhythm.en: The drummer kept a steady rhythm throughout the entire performance.
rhythm.zh: 鼓手在整場演出中維持穩定節奏。

rib.en: The biology model shows how each rib helps protect the chest.
rib.zh: 生物模型顯示每根肋骨如何協助保護胸腔。

ribbon.en: She tied a blue ribbon around the science fair display.
ribbon.zh: 她在科展展示板周圍繫上一條藍色緞帶。

riches.en: The story suggests that knowledge can matter more than riches.
riches.zh: 故事暗示知識有時比財富更重要。

rid.en: The cleanup project helped rid the beach of scattered plastic waste.
rid.zh: 清潔活動幫助清除海灘上的零散塑膠垃圾。

riddle.en: The teacher began class with a short riddle about numbers.
riddle.zh: 老師用一道關於數字的小謎題開始上課。

ridge.en: The hiking trail follows a narrow ridge above the valley.
ridge.zh: 登山步道沿著山谷上方的狹窄稜線前進。

ridiculous.en: The claim sounded ridiculous until the experiment produced supporting evidence.
ridiculous.zh: 這項主張原本聽起來荒謬，直到實驗提出支持證據。

scout.en: A scout recorded bird species observed during the weekend nature walk.
scout.zh: 一名童軍記錄週末自然觀察中看到的鳥類。

scramble.en: Students had to scramble to finish the display before the deadline.
scramble.zh: 學生必須趕在截止前完成展示。

scrap.en: The art club reused each scrap of paper for a collage.
scrap.zh: 美術社把每一小片廢紙重新用在拼貼作品中。
